_comment: Branch protection for `develop` — US-01.1.1 T-01.1.1.3. Applied by scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh, asserted by scripts/verify-branch-protection.sh. Do not edit on GitHub directly; edit here and re-apply so the configuration stays reviewable and restorable.
_strict_note: required_status_checks.strict = true enforces 'branch must be up to date before merging' (AC-2). First required check registered: commit-lint (US-01.1.2). Remaining contexts land with the CI pipeline (US-01.4.x): build, unit-tests, integration-tests, coverage, architecture-fitness, sast, dependency-scan.
_enforce_admins_note: AC-4 — administrators cannot push directly to develop.
_reviews_note: DEVIATION from AC-2/AC-3: required_approving_review_count is 0 and require_code_owner_reviews is false. GitHub never requests review from a PR author, and this repository has one owner, so any non-zero requirement would block every merge permanently. Raise to 1 (2 for ACS/security paths) and enable code-owner review the moment a second collaborator or an organisation exists. See docs/project/13-branch-protection.md.
_linear_note: develop takes squash merges from feature branches, so history is linear by construction. main differs — see main.json.
